name: rtk (Rust Token Killer)
what: CLI proxy that filters and compresses shell command output. `rtk init -g` installs a Claude Code PreToolUse hook that rewrites Bash calls (e.g. git status -> rtk git status). Hook fires on Bash only; Read/Grep/Glob are not rewritten.
claimed_saving: 60-90% on common dev commands; 'up to 90%' bash output; README sample: git status ~3,000 -> 600 tokens, cargo test 25,000 -> 2,500 tokens (medium TS and Rust projects).
evidence: Self-reported README numbers, no per-command benchmark or test setup on the page; token counts estimated as bytes/4. Only affects Bash tool results, not the 43k system floor or cache writes. License: rtk CLI Apache-2.0, but rtk-engine and rtk-proxy are BUSL-1.1 (no commercial offering to third parties). Name collision with an unrelated crates.io 'rtk'.
last_update: Not shown on page (2,398 commits on develop; no releases listed)

name: context-mode (mksglu)
what: MCP server plus sandbox: raw tool output (commands, file dumps, API results) is processed in a subprocess and only a summary enters context; tools such as ctx_execute and ctx_index. Install as a Claude Code plugin: /plugin marketplace add mksglu/context-mode.
claimed_saving: 315 KB -> 5.4 KB session (98%); per tool: 56 KB -> 299 B (ctx_execute), 60 KB -> 40 B (ctx_index).
evidence: Headline numbers from README; measurement method lives in BENCHMARK.md (not read). Model must call its tools instead of raw Bash/Read, so real savings depend on adoption per call. Vendor-reported.
last_update: Not shown on page (2,234 commits; no releases listed). License: Elastic License 2.0 (not OSI open source).

name: context-compress (npm, context-mode derivative)
what: TypeScript rewrite of context-mode with security hardening; an aggressive mode keeps raw data searchable via FTS5/BM25 and returns a compressed result.
claimed_saving: 93% token reduction in aggressive mode (per listing).
evidence: Only the npm listing summary was read; no benchmark fetched.
last_update: Listing versions 2026.3.3 and 2026.3.20 seen in search results

name: Claude Code hook: preprocess output before Claude reads it (official pattern)
what: Official docs recommend PreToolUse hooks that rewrite Bash commands to filter output, e.g. run tests with 2>&1 | grep -A 5 -E '(FAIL|ERROR|error:)' | head -100. Also: delegate verbose operations to subagents so only a summary returns; keep CLAUDE.md under 200 lines; move workflow instructions to skills (loaded on demand).
claimed_saving: Qualitative only: 'a 10,000-line log' reduced to matching lines, 'tens of thousands of tokens to hundreds'. No percentage given.
evidence: Official Anthropic docs, Manage costs page (current, references v2.1.293-era features). This is the no-dependency version of rtk.

name: Claude Code advisor tool (advisorModel / --advisor / /advisor)
what: Pairs a cheaper main model with a stronger advisor that Claude consults at decision points. Set via /advisor <model>, settings key advisorModel, or claude --advisor <model>. Kill switch CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ADVISOR_TOOL=1. Advisor must rank at or above the main model: Sonnet 5.5 main accepts Opus 5+ advisor; Opus 5/5.5 main accepts only Opus 5+ or Fable (no cheaper advisor, so no saving for an Opus-main fleet); Haiku 4.5 cannot advise.
claimed_saving: No number in Claude Code docs. Docs say pairing 'typically costs less than running the stronger model throughout'. Advisor tokens bill at the advisor model rate on API, and count against plan limits on subscriptions.
evidence: Official docs. Experimental; needs Anthropic API (not Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry); feature-flag fetch must be on (DISABLE_TELEMETRY turns it off). Advisor reads the full transcript each call with no cache reuse, so cost scales with call count.

name: Anthropic: The advisor strategy (blog)
what: Anthropic's case for Sonnet or Haiku executor with Opus advisor, via the API advisor server tool; max_uses caps advisor calls per request; advisor tokens reported separately in usage.
claimed_saving: Sonnet+Opus advisor on SWE-bench Multilingual: +2.7 points vs Sonnet alone, cost per agentic task -11.9%. Haiku+Opus on BrowseComp: 41.2% vs 19.7% solo Haiku; article says it trails Sonnet solo by 29% at 85% lower cost per task.
evidence: Blog text, published 2026-04-09. Baselines are Sonnet alone, not Opus alone, so these are not savings versus an Opus fleet. Charts with Terminal-Bench and BrowseComp Sonnet figures were not readable in text. No Claude Code settings mentioned.

name: Anthropic API pricing (cache write and read multipliers)
what: Current per-MTok table used to size levers. Opus 5.5: input $4, 5m cache write $5, 1h cache write $8, cache hit $0.20, output $20. Sonnet 5.5: input $2, 5m write $2.50, 1h write $4, hit $0.10, output $10. Haiku 5.5 (<=100k prompt): input $0.10, 5m write $0.125, 1h write $0.20, hit $0.01, output $0.50.
claimed_saving: Arithmetic: 1h write is 1.6x a 5m write on Opus 5.5 and 1.6x on Sonnet 5.5, so FORCE_PROMPT_CACHING_5M=1 cuts each write price by 37.5% but adds rewrites after any idle gap over 5 min. Sonnet 5.5 is half Opus 5.5 price on input and output. Rough breakeven: 5m wins only if the prefix is rewritten fewer than ~1.6 times per hour.
evidence: Official pricing table fetched 2026-10-16 (full table in tool-results file). Quota-side savings still need measurement with /usage Prompt cache line.

name: Claude Code cache TTL env vars (CLAUDE_CODE_PROMPT_CACHE_TTL, ENABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_1H, FORCE_PROMPT_CACHING_5M)
what: CLAUDE_CODE_PROMPT_CACHE_TTL accepts only 5m or 1h for the main conversation; it takes precedence over promptCacheTtl and ENABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_1H. FORCE_PROMPT_CACHING_5M overrides it to 5m. ENABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_1H=1 selects 1h (added v2.1.108 for API key, Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry; ENABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_1H_BEDROCK is deprecated but honored). DISABLE_PROMPT_CACHING disables caching.
claimed_saving: Not claimed by docs. Lever for the 30% of spend on 1h writes: pin 5m (FORCE_PROMPT_CACHING_5M=1 or CLAUDE_CODE_PROMPT_CACHE_TTL=5m) when sessions idle less than 5 min, keep 1h when they idle longer.
evidence: Official env-vars page (TTL row confirmed; FORCE_ and ENABLE_ rows not in the read window). A closed GitHub issue (claudeissues #49139, Apr 2026) reports ENABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_1H had no effect for an API key user; check on your version with the Prompt cache line in /usage.

name: Claude Code thinking and effort env vars (CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL, MAX_THINKING_TOKENS, CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_THINKING, CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ADAPTIVE_THINKING)
what: CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL = low|medium|high|xhigh|max|auto (overrides /effort and effortLevel). MAX_THINKING_TOKENS sets a fixed thinking budget, only on fixed-budget models; adaptive models ignore nonzero budgets. CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_THINKING=1 removes the thinking parameter but does NOT turn thinking off on Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Haiku 5.5 or Fable. CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ADAPTIVE_THINKING=1 falls back to the fixed budget on Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 only.
claimed_saving: Not quantified. Output incl. thinking is 26% of spend; on Opus 5.5 the effort level is the only working knob (MAX_THINKING_TOKENS is ignored there).
evidence: Official env-vars and costs pages. Thinking is billed as output tokens at $20/MTok on Opus 5.5.

name: Claude Code output-size caps (BASH_MAX_OUTPUT_LENGTH, CLAUDE_CODE_FILE_READ_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS, CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS)
what: BASH_MAX_OUTPUT_LENGTH: max characters of bash output read back into a result, default 30000, max 150000 (ignored if bashOutputMaxChars setting set). CLAUDE_CODE_FILE_READ_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS: file read limit, default 25,000 tokens. CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS: cap on output per request.
claimed_saving: Not quantified by docs. Lowering BASH_MAX_OUTPUT_LENGTH from 30000 cuts the worst-case size of each noisy command result (e.g. 8000 chars = roughly 1/4 of the default ceiling).
evidence: Official env-vars page, read in the first 100k characters.

name: Claude Code tool-surface caps (CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_* and MCP description length)
what: Disable built-ins: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_WEB_FETCH (keeps WebSearch), CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPLORE_PLAN_AGENTS, CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BACKGROUND_TASKS, CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_CRON, CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ARTIFACT, CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_WORKFLOWS, CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_FAST_MODE, CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_1M_CONTEXT, CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ADVISOR_TOOL. CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_MCP_DESCRIPTION_LENGTH caps MCP description chars (default 4096; 16384 for tools loaded via tool search). Official docs: MCP tool definitions are deferred by default, so only names enter context until used.
claimed_saving: Not quantified. Each disabled built-in removes its schema from the per-call floor; MCP servers are the main floor lever (check with /context).
evidence: Official env-vars and costs pages. ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH is not in the official pages read; third-party guide says it takes auto, auto:N (0-100), true, false, and that Haiku does not support it.

name: MCP tool search: deferral values and known bugs (third-party)
what: Third-party guide to ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH (unset/true defers all; auto loads tools upfront if within ~10% of context; auto:N custom threshold; false loads all upfront). Per-server alwaysLoad exemption. Known issues: HTTP/Streamable-HTTP MCP tools not deferred in some versions (anthropics/claude-code issue 40314); defer_loading in .claude.json had no effect in one report (claudeissues 26844).
claimed_saving: Third-party sources cite about 85% reduction in tool-definition tokens for tool search (not verified).
evidence: Secondary guide plus GitHub issue reports; verify the exact values against the Claude Code version in use with /context before and after.

name: ccusage (ryoppippi)
what: CLI that reads local Claude Code JSONL and reports tokens and USD by input, output, cache create and cache read. Commands: daily, weekly, monthly, session, blocks (5-hour windows, live), statusline; source-specific e.g. ccusage claude daily. MIT.
claimed_saving: None (meter). Use to baseline per-seat and per-model cache share before changing TTL, effort or advisor.
evidence: GitHub page fetched. Measurement tool, not a reduction tool.
last_update: Not shown on page (2,706 commits on main; no releases listed)

claimed_saving: None stated in the search summary.

name: Claude Code /usage Prompt cache line and cost guidance (official)
what: Official cost page. /usage Session block shows a 'Prompt cache (main)' line (v2.1.251+): share of input from cache, misses, expected rebuilds, warm/cold and TTL. /usage plan breakdown attributes usage to skills, subagents, plugins and MCP servers. Cache lifetime is 1h on subscriptions and drops to 5m when drawing on usage credits; 5m by default on API keys and cloud providers. Also: use model: haiku for simple subagents; keep agent teams small; /effort or disable thinking to save output.
claimed_saving: None quantified. Best free measurement for the cache TTL and rebuild decision.
